concept: VPC: DB in a private subnet, SG references the app-tier SG
tests: How to place the database tier of a three-tier app so it's unreachable from the internet but reachable by the app tier.
expected: Private subnet with no route to an IGW + a DB security group allowing traffic only from the app-tier security group. Triggers: "not reachable from the internet", "accessed by the application tier".
why_not: A public subnet, the load balancer's subnet or a route to an internet gateway make the DB reachable from the internet.
